sourceFacts: male, age thirty-one, Xuandun International old-city patrol captain under Bai Yuan
appearance is so ordinary that he disappears quickly in a crowd
never shirks patrol duty and always drinks one extra cup of tea in the booth before each patrol
blind-spot sense only identifies one likely breach in long-familiar territory; standard portrait must not show radar, wall vision, target outlines or surveillance HUD
designAssumptions: average Chinese man with ordinary short black hair, brown eyes, an unremarkable face and medium build
plain washed blue-grey patrol jacket over a light matte protective vest, black trousers, simple utility belt and work boots
holds a plain off-white ceramic teacup with both hands near his waist and looks down at it before beginning patrol
sceneConcept: An average thirty-one-year-old Chinese old-city patrol captain stands alone against a transparent background with deliberately unremarkable features. Ordinary short black hair, brown eyes and a medium build make him easy to overlook. He wears a completely plain washed blue-grey patrol jacket over a light matte protective vest, straight black trousers, a simple utility belt and work boots. Before patrol, he holds a plain off-white ceramic teacup with both hands near his waist and looks down at it in a quiet habitual pause. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the silhouette mundane and credible.
naturalLanguageDetail: An deliberately ordinary thirty-one-year-old Chinese old-city patrol captain in a completely plain washed blue-grey patrol jacket and light protective vest holds a plain off-white ceramic teacup with both hands near his waist and looks down at it before patrol under soft even frontal studio light.
